_comment: CURATED Realm Rework data, re-verified 2026-10 (see META.md §1). Source: RealmEye /wiki/the-realm + /wiki/beacons + DECA patch notes (Realm Rework, Season 25 Snowfall, S28 P2 Realm Legions, S29 Alien Invasion, S30 encounters). The realm is biomes (rookie->adept->veteran). Each biome has a Beacon guarded by a Beacon Guardian; killing it activates the beacon (minimap fast-travel + safe heal zone + speed-boost roads, and since late 2025 activation also clears nearby enemies). Guardians (Heroes of Oryx) can spawn an Encounter; the reworked Veteran guardians have Biome-UT loot tables. Biome UTs are legendary-forge-tier and drop ONLY from that biome's enemies/encounters. 'statPots' = stat potions the biome's open-world enemies drop. 'ut' = null where the per-biome item isn't verified yet (TODO: scraper). 'dungeons' = dungeon portal ids that spawn in the biome. 'encounters' = notable named encounters (not exhaustive).

tiers.rookie: Leveling biomes (no stat pots). Level to 20 here.
tiers.adept: Godlands-tier. Primary source of the 6 stat pots. Since S29 its Alien Reactors drive the Alien Invasion event (can start at 15% Realm Score).
tiers.veteran: Tougher. Adds the once-dungeon-exclusive Life & Mana pots, Biome UTs from reworked guardians, and the Realm Legions bases (Legion Watchtower / Strategy Center / Research Base) whose Legion Elite bosses drop T13/T6-equivalent Legion Elite gear.

coral-reefs.note: Fishing hub — beacon active by default.

sprite-forest.note: Daughter of Limon always drops a Puppet Master's Encore portal.

abandoned-city.note: Mixed pots. The Maze Minotaur always drops a Puppet Master's Encore portal.

carboniferous.note: Both portals here are mid-tier Life/Mana sources (Woodland → Life, Crawling Depths → Mana).

sanguine-forest.note: Shadow Lurker can drop a Puppet Master's Encore portal.

runic-tundra.note: Home of two exalt dungeons: Ice Citadel (SPD) and Kogbold Steamworks (VIT).
